backend/main.mo: Defines the main actor with user profiles, jobs, applications, credit management, and helper functions for employer/jobseeker checks and data storage maps.
feature_evidence.json: Lists feature evidence entries mapping features to affected frontend files, components, and test IDs with confidence annotations.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Contains prewritten summaries of numerous frontend files describing their purpose in routing, UI components, hooks, and utilities.
frontend/docs/missing-canister-functions: Documents backend methods required by the frontend, highlighting which are implemented, missing, and issues such as incomplete candidate directory data.
frontend/index.css: Defines global Tailwind CSS variables and themes, including light/dark palettes and base element styling.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point that loads the React application root and bootstraps the main TypeScript module.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Sets up TanStack Router routes, authentication guards, theming, and application layout providers for the main app.
frontend/src/auth/manualAuthTypes.ts: Defines TypeScript types for manual authentication roles, sessions, credentials, and experience entries.
frontend/src/components/admin/AdminCredi: Admin form to view and update the credit cost per candidate unlock.
frontend/src/components/admin/AdminEmplo: Admin table listing employers with actions to add or deduct credits.
frontend/src/components/admin/AdminJobse: Admin table listing jobseekers and their status.
frontend/src/components/admin/AdminMetri: Displays admin dashboard metrics like total employers, jobseekers, and credits used.
frontend/src/components/admin/AdminUnloc: Admin table showing unlock logs including employer, candidate, credits, and timestamp.
frontend/src/components/AppFooter.tsx: Footer component with copyright text, caffeine.ai attribution, and simple navigation links.
frontend/src/components/AppHeader.tsx: Header with navigation, role-based links, user menu, and mobile sheet menu.
frontend/src/components/AppLayout.tsx: Wraps pages with header, footer, and role-based layout styling.
frontend/src/components/applications/Can: Empty placeholder file for a candidate application form.
frontend/src/components/auth/InternetIde: Empty placeholder for a help dialog about Internet Identity.
frontend/src/components/auth/LoginPage.t: Login page supporting multiple roles with shared form logic and role-based redirects.
frontend/src/components/auth/ProtectedRo: Route guard enforcing authentication, role permissions, and profile completion.
frontend/src/components/auth/RoleSetupMo: Empty placeholder for a role setup modal.
Signup form handling email/password validation and role selection, then calling signup and navigating to profile setup.
frontend/src/components/employer/Candida: Displays candidate info with locked/unlocked states and triggers an unlock confirmation dialog.
frontend/src/components/employer/UnlockC: Dialog showing unlock cost, current credits, and confirming profile unlock.
frontend/src/components/jobs/EmployerJob: Empty placeholder file for employer job form.
frontend/src/components/jobs/JobCard.tsx: Empty placeholder file for job card component.
frontend/src/components/profile/ProfileS: Profile setup form for jobseekers and employers with experience handling and profile submission.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages an authenticated or anonymous actor and invalidates dependent queries on change.
frontend/src/hooks/useAdminQueries.ts: React Query hooks for admin operations like listing users, unlock logs, and managing credits.
frontend/src/hooks/useEmployerCredits.ts: Hooks to fetch employer credit balance and per-unlock credit cost.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Implements a React context and provider for Internet Identity authentication using AuthClient, managing identity load, login, and error states.
frontend/src/hooks/useManualAuth.tsx: Provides a localStorage‑backed manual auth system with signup, login, logout, and profile completion tracking for demo use.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query hooks for fetching and saving user profiles and candidate directory data via an actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useUnlockCandidate.ts: Mutation hook that unlocks a candidate profile through the actor and refreshes related queries.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS setup with light/dark themes and role‑specific accent variables.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point setting up React Query and Internet Identity providers before rendering App.
Admin dashboard with metrics and tabbed views for employers, jobseekers, credits, and unlock logs.
frontend/src/pages/CandidateDashboardPag: Candidate dashboard displaying profile info, skills, and placeholder sections for applications and saved jobs.
frontend/src/pages/EmployerCandidatesPag: Employer page for browsing, filtering, and unlocking candidate profiles with credit display and search options.
frontend/src/pages/EmployerDashboardPage: Empty placeholder file for the employer dashboard page.
frontend/src/pages/EmployerJobApplicatio: Empty placeholder file for the employer job applications page.
frontend/src/pages/JobDetailPage.tsx: Empty placeholder file for a job detail view.
frontend/src/pages/JobsBrowsePage.tsx: Empty placeholder file for browsing jobs.
frontend/src/pages/LandingPage.tsx: Landing page with hero, feature cards, and calls to action for job seekers and employers.
frontend/src/utils/actorDiagnostics.ts: Utilities to check backend actor methods and report missing ones with console diagnostics.
frontend/src/utils/actorErrorMessages.ts: Normalizes actor-related errors into user-friendly messages and identifies specific error types.
frontend/src/utils/actorGuards.ts: Provides guards for safely calling actor methods, throwing custom errors when methods are missing.
frontend/src/utils/formatInr.ts: Formats and parses amounts in Indian Rupees, supporting compact lakh formatting.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Helpers for reading, persisting, and clearing URL parameters with sessionStorage support.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration defining theme extensions, colors, shadows, and animations.
project_state.json: Contains the project state, feature requirements, known issues, and new feature requests for implementing custom signup and Jobseeker Profile Setup. Highlights a post‑signup loading bug and details form behaviors including dynamic experience entries.
